newsitem.title: USA: Provident holders okay Revere proposals.
newsitem.headline: Provident holders okay Revere proposals.

text.p: Provident Cos Inc said on Tuesday its shareholders approved proposals needed to complete its acquisition of the Paul Revere Corp.

The proposals were the issuance of shares of Provident Cos common stock, under the amended and restated agreement and plan of merger, the issuance of Provident shares related to the Zurich purchase agreement and an amendment to Provident's restated certificate of incorporation, it said.
This amendment increased the number of shares Provident was authorized to issue to 150 million from 65 million.
Zurich Insurance Group is investing $300 million in Provident as part of acquisition. Provident said its shareholders had to approve the issuance of 9.5 million shares to Zurich.
The company said the number of shares it issued to Paul Revere would depend on which of three options Paul Revere chose -- all cash, all stock or a mixture of stock and cash.

In September, Paul Revere and Provident Cos announced a delay to Provident's $1.2 billion acquisition of Paul Revere. The companies said the delay was partly due to Paul Revere studying its individual disability reserves.
The companies also said they needed to address related issues in the review process for the joint proxy statement being prepared for shareholder votes.
In November, Textron, which owns 83 percent of Paul Revere, said they agreed Textron would provide addition capital to Paul Revere.
Provident said its acquisition was still subject to the approval of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts Division of Insurance.
